name: Make a Server!
desc:
MaS is a sandbox game created by sadrt64.

🧭 Discover great servers ready for you to join.
🔨 Create your own server.
🚀 Use powerful tools to build your space.
🔄 Customize your server settings easily.
🎉 Host fun activities for everyone.
🏰 Work together on creative projects and design breathtaking builds.
⭐ Most importantly, have fun!
